name: Abu Kabir
discoveryMethod: Separate first-party English and Egyptian-Arabic discovery, official ESA page review, Sharqia district-route inspection, and bounded anonymous GET checks of public pages; no parcel API route was exposed.
queryOutcomes: English and Arabic discovery both identified the Egyptian General Survey Authority as the national survey/map custodian. ESA's official digital-map page documents a paid/request workflow requiring location, scale, layers, format, and projection; its district page links a Sharqia office map. No public parcel viewer, JavaScript map configuration, service URL, native parcel schema, or anonymous parcel geometry response was found. The government land-survey statement URL failed TLS verification because its certificate was expired; the certificate was not bypassed.

attempts.query: Egypt official cadastral map parcel viewer Abu Kabir Sharqia cadastral map Egyptian General Survey Authority
attempts.outcome: First-party ESA main site, digital-map page, and district-map route found; no public Abu Kabir parcel API/viewer found.

attempts.query: أبو كبير الشرقية خريطة كادسترية قطع الأراضي الهيئة المصرية العامة للمساحة
attempts.outcome: First-party Arabic ESA pages and the Sharqia district route found; no public parcel API/viewer found.
Official Arabic ESA page loaded; it identifies survey/property-map responsibilities and links map services.
Official digital-map page loaded. It documents formal purchase/request steps and offers scale choices 1:50000, 1:2500, and 1:5000; no public parcel query endpoint or schema was exposed.
Official district page loaded. Its image map links the Sharqia district office map; it does not provide parcel geometry or parcel identifiers.
Sharqia district JPEG loaded as an office/district route; no parcel feature data.
Official general-map catalog loaded; it contained country/region map products, not a city parcel viewer or feature service.
TLS certificate verification failed because the certificate was expired. No retry with verification disabled was made.

sourceAssessment.localCustodian: No Abu Kabir-specific local cadastral custodian was evidenced. The Egyptian General Survey Authority is the evidenced national survey/map custodian; the ESA Sharqia district route is an office/contact route only.
sourceAssessment.publicService: No public parcel service was evidenced. The strongest official candidate is ESA's digital-map request/catalog page, which requires a formal request and delivery workflow rather than anonymous feature queries.
sourceAssessment.nativeFieldsObserved: No parcel-layer fields or native parcel identifiers were exposed by the inspected official pages.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if a future official parcel feature response exposes one
scopeLimits: ESA national custody does not establish citywide parcel coverage for Abu Kabir.
The official digital-map workflow is request/purchase based; no anonymous parcel geometry or ID response was available.
The Sharqia JPEG is an office/district route, not parcel evidence.
The failed government service TLS check and absence of a public viewer are availability findings, not evidence of cadastral absence.
A zero exact-point hit, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI would not establish citywide absence; no such absence inference was made.
No GeoJSON sample is included because no unchanged native parcel geometry with a safe native identity was obtained.
No unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Research completion does not constitute source integration, adapter admission, or runtime qualification.
uncertainty: The national official custodian and an official Sharqia route are established, but Abu Kabir-specific parcel coverage, public service availability, native identity fields, CRS, geometry access, and adapter qualification remain unresolved.
pointBasis: Immutable WUP queue point; retained exactly and not shifted to seek a parcel hit.
